CA.rationale: No attention/allocation relation to content is present; A is absent.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates), an explicit origin/organization entry, and a separate status/origin are present for the same referent and time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition is linked to the identified contents' presentation or access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifications (color-tagged coordinate sets) are listed with referents and times.

D.rationale: Content identity (red coordinate set) is presented separately from its status/origin (copied_prior_record) for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: The report states how coordinates map to rows/columns (display layout) and includes explicit origin/representation entries describing how contents are organized/accessed in the model.
